title: Upload ready-made animations into the folder being browsed
summary: Upload existing ODRG/ODRGX bytes without conversion into the displayed destination, preserving the explored External folder. Storage is selectable; every new upload defaults to External when detected, otherwise automatically selects Internal and grays out External. Original software and artifacts delivered. Owner-authorized follow-up fixes Clocks unexpectedly returning to Root after transient lookup failures; refreshed APK delivery is pending. Physical board/phone acceptance remains open.
